requirements.text: Personalised timetable management that includes colour-coding for modules
Ability to hide cancelled classes in the timetable
Option for students to add personal study blocks in their timetable
Automated grade notifications for when new grades are posted
Reminders for assignment deadlines and exams
Allow students to tailor the frequency of notifications to their preferences
Structured module feedback system that allows students to provide feedback on content quality and delivery
Ensure anonymity for students providing feedback
Integrate new features smoothly with the existing portal infrastructure to maintain stability
